cancellation_summary: Cancellations are allowed with a 24-hour advance notice.
description: The Pearl Harbor Remembered tour immerses visitors in history, from the events leading to the Pearl Harbor attack to its aftermath. Experience multimedia exhibits, a boat ride to the USS Arizona Memorial, a tour of the Battleship Missouri, and downtown Honolulu’s rich cultural history.
what_is_included:
- Admission to Pearl Harbor Visitor Center
- USS Arizona Memorial entry
- Battleship Missouri tour
- Downtown Honolulu drive-by
what_is_not_included: - Storage for bags at Pearl Harbor ($8.00 per bag)
itinerary:
- **Pick-up:** From Waikiki 
- **Pearl Harbor Visitor Center:** Exhibits and multimedia displays
- **USS Arizona Memorial:** Boat ride and guided experience
- **Battleship Missouri:** Tour of the iconic battleship
- **Downtown Honolulu:** Drive-by of historic landmarks
- **Return:** To Waikiki or Ko’Olina
highlights:
- Explore Pearl Harbor Visitor Center exhibits
- Visit the USS Arizona Memorial
- Tour the historic Battleship Missouri
- Drive through downtown Honolulu’s landmarks
what_to_bring:
- Government-issued ID
- Comfortable clothing and shoes
- No large bags (storage available for $8.00 per bag)
special_requirements: - Notify in advance for wheelchair or scooter accommodations
restrictions: - No iPad cases, clutch wallets, or oversized bags allowed
disclaimers:
- Security restrictions at Pearl Harbor will been forced. 
- Please do not bring large bags or anything that could offer concealment. 
- Storage is available at Pearl Harbor for $8.00.
- Due to construction and lane closures surrounding Pearl Harbor, delays may occur on Pearl Harbor Tours.
- Please call to reconfirm your tour at least 24 hours prior.
- Please report any disability requiring special attention at time of booking. E Noa will make all reasonable attempts to accommodate the visitor’s needs.
- All reservations subject to availability with departure times, dates, schedules and fares subject to change without notice.
- E Noa Corporation shall not be liable for any injury, loss, damage, or accident to persons or property of any individual on tour from any cause beyond its control.
- Due to unforeseen circumstances beyond our control, the Navy may suspend boat operations to the USS Arizona Memorial at any time. In such cases, there will be no refunds. You can still enjoy the USS Arizona film, exhibits, visitor's center, and park monuments.
faqs:
- **What should I wear?** Comfortable clothing and shoes; swimsuits are not allowed.
- **Are there storage options?** Yes, bag storage is available for $8.00 per bag.
- **Do I need ID?** Yes, a government-issued ID is required.
